claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings, targeting plateau pressure <30 cmH2O and appropriate tidal volume.
Continue invasive hemodynamic monitoring with arterial line and central venous pressure, maintaining mean arterial pressure >65 mmHg.
Wean supplemental oxygen as tolerated to maintain SpO2 92-96%, avoiding hyperoxia.
Assess and manage pain, titrating analgesics to maintain comfort and facilitate respiratory mechanics.
Monitor blood glucose and continue insulin therapy to maintain glucose 140-180 mg/dL.
Obtain daily chest radiograph to evaluate pulmonary status and line positions.
Monitor electrolytes and renal function, repeating basic metabolic panel as clinically indicated.
Perform sedation and delirium assessment using RASS and CAM-ICU, targeting RASS 0 to -2.
Provide venous thromboembolism prophylaxis with pharmacologic or mechanical measures as appropriate.
Mobilize patient as tolerated with physical therapy and progressive activity.
